name: Money Plant (गुलाब की बेल)
description: Low maintenance indoor trailing plant that purifies air and grows in low light conditions. Perfect for beginners.
care: Water once a week, keep in indirect light, mist occasionally

name: Snake Plant (सांपों की बेल)
description: Hardy succulent that filters air toxins. Thrives on neglect with minimal water needs.
care: Water every 2-3 weeks, tolerates low light, prefers dry soil

name: Spider Plant (मकड़ी का पौधा)
description: Produces cascading runners with baby plants. Non-toxic and very hardy for indoor spaces.
care: Water regularly, bright indirect light, remove brown tips

name: Pothos (पोथोस)
description: Easy-to-grow vine plant that tolerates various light conditions and improves air quality.
care: Water when soil is dry, can survive low light, trim for bushiness

name: Peace Lily (शांति का फूल)
description: Elegant plant with white flowers. Adapts well indoors and droops when thirsty.
care: Water when top soil is dry, prefers low to medium light

name: Rose (गुलाब)
description: Beautiful flowering plant available in multiple colors. Requires full sunlight and regular care.
care: Full sun 6+ hours, water in morning, remove dead flowers

name: Jasmine (चमेली/मोगरा)
description: Fragrant flowering vine. Blooms profusely in sunlight with delicate white flowers.
care: Needs full sun, daily watering in summer, prune after flowering

name: Hibiscus (गुड़हल)
description: Tropical flowering plant with large vibrant flowers. Blooms year-round in warm climates.
care: Full sun, water regularly, fertilize monthly, prune for shape

name: Bougainvillea (बौगेनविलिया)
description: Stunning colored bracts that last long. Very drought tolerant once established.
care: Full sun required, water deeply but infrequently, minimal fertilizer

name: Marigold (गेंदे का फूल)
description: Bright cheerful flowers perfect for gardens and pots. Annual bloomer.
care: Full sun, water at soil level, deadhead spent flowers

name: Lemon Plant (कागज़ी नींबू)
description: Compact lemon tree that produces seedless lemons. Fruits even in containers.
care: Full sun 6+ hours, water regularly, fertilize monthly, prune crowded branches

name: Orange Plant (संतरा)
description: Dwarf citrus tree suitable for balconies and small gardens. Fruits in 2-3 years.
care: Full sun, water deeply, apply fertilizer every 6 weeks

name: Guava Plant (अमरूद)
description: Hardy fruit tree that produces abundantly. Very nutritious white or pink fruits.
care: Full sun, water weekly, prune after harvest, minimal pest issues

name: Pomegranate (अनार)
description: Deciduous tree bearing beautiful red fruits rich in antioxidants.
care: Full sun essential, drought tolerant once established, prune in spring

name: Mango Plant (आम)
description: King of fruits tree. Requires patience but rewards with abundant harvests.
care: Full sun, deep watering during growing season, well-drained soil

name: Mint Plant (पुदीना)
description: Aromatic herb used in cooking and tea. Very easy to grow and spreads quickly.
care: Partial shade okay, water regularly, harvest leaves regularly

name: Tulsi Plant (तुलसी)
description: Sacred plant with medicinal properties. Used for tea and spiritual purposes.
care: Full sun 4-6 hours, water in morning, pinch flowers for bushiness

name: Aloe Vera (एलोवेरा)
description: Medicinal succulent gel used for burns and skin care. Very low maintenance.
care: Bright light, water sparingly, well-draining soil essential

name: Cactus Mix (कैक्टस)
description: Collection of colorful cacti. Drought-resistant and ideal for sunny locations.
care: Full sun, minimal water (monthly in winter), sandy soil

name: ZZ Plant (जेड का पौधा)
description: Tough glossy plant that tolerates neglect and low light remarkably well.
care: Low to bright indirect light, water every 2-3 weeks, drought tolerant

name: Rubber Plant (रबर का पौधा)
description: Large leafed statement plant that improves indoor air quality significantly.
care: Bright indirect light, water when top inch dry, wipe leaves monthly

name: Neem Plant (नीम)
description: Multi-purpose medicinal tree. Leaves, seeds, and oil have numerous health benefits.
care: Full sun preferred, water regularly when young, drought tolerant when mature

name: Peppermint (पेप्परमिंट)
description: Refreshing aromatic herb. Grows vigorously and used for tea and cooking.
care: Partial shade, moist soil, trim regularly to prevent legginess

name: Sunflower (सूरजमुखी)
description: Tall annual with bright yellow flowers following the sun. Great for gardens.
care: Full sun essential, water regularly, stake tall varieties
